name: dftracer_optimize_compute
description: Compute component of the dftracer optimizer: the 10-dimension compute checklist (vectorization, kernel/library selection, overlap, compiler flags, threading, auto-tuning, frequency, NUMA, hardware capability) and built-in L1/L2/L3 strategies for compute_time (opt_compute_checklist); dftracer_optimize_compute_check validates the findings table.
